_note: Hierarchy tree = AD_Tree (keyed by Name; what Element 'tree' resolves). treeType picks the area (EV = account/element-value tree for the chart of accounts). 'table' is the underlying table for the tree's nodes. NOTE: records of tree-supported tables (C_ElementValue, AD_Org, M_Product, C_BP_Group, C_Activity, C_Campaign, C_SalesRegion) are AUTOMATICALLY added as nodes to their tree by the model on insert - so creating an account (Element.accounts) attaches it to the element's tree with no extra step. Placing a node under a specific parent in the hierarchy is a separate tree-node operation.

fields.help: all records must be in the tree
node table, e.g. C_ElementValue for an account tree
